name: cable standing high cross neutral grip triceps extension
description: A triceps pushdown with the cable set high and the handles crossed, using a neutral grip. It isolates the back of the arm.
instructions: Set both pulleys high and stand in the middle, holding the handles with palms facing in.
Cross your hands in front of your chest with elbows tucked to your sides.
Press the handles down and out until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the handles rise back slowly without moving your elbows.
